title: Foreign PEP (senior official) running a crypto exchange in Nigeria
narrative: A Nigerian government minister applies for a business account for a digital-asset exchange (LLC, cryptocurrency) expecting $250,000 a month. The PEP database returns a senior-official match. Nigeria is on the FATF list of jurisdictions under increased monitoring. No sanctions hit. (Demo profile 2 from data_generator.py. The synthetic PEP source identifies officials by the title in the name field.)

application.source_of_funds: Business revenue from digital asset exchange

rationale: FATF Recommendation 12 requires senior management approval before establishing a relationship with a foreign PEP, plus source-of-wealth checks. Combined with a high-risk sector and a monitored jurisdiction, this cannot be approved by software even with enhanced due diligence attached: it must be escalated, at high risk.
